findings.finding: Transport Fever 3, published by Paradox, launched on 29 September 2026, two days before the quarter closed. It peaked at ~48k concurrent Steam players, double Transport Fever 2's ~24k record, after reaching No. 1 on Steam's global bestseller list on pre-orders. Pre-order and launch-day revenue should therefore land in Q3 and push revenue above the 446 MSEK bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue beat consensus by 2.3% (524 vs 512) but EBIT missed by 7.6%, and the stock fell 7.6%. Revenue beats have not been rewarded here when EBIT lags.
findings.original_quote: Steamでの同時接続プレイヤー数を確認すると、これまでのピーク時には約4万8000人に達した … 200万本以上を売り上げた前作『Transport Fever 2』の最高記録（約2万4000人）をすでに大きく上回っている (Japanese: Steam CCU peaked at ~48,000, already well above the ~24,000 record of the predecessor, which sold over 2 million copies)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The launch has been public since 30 September, yet the stock fell 10.7% over 20 sessions. Two things suggest consensus does not hold all of the Q3 slice. Bloomberg's 446 MSEK is +13% YoY, about what the core catalogue alone implies: Steam engagement +8.7% YoY plus a ~4% FX tailwind gives roughly 440 MSEK, leaving little room for a launch. And Handelsbanken's 7 October cut called new launches dilutive to earnings, so they are modelled as a cost. If the market had priced a TF3 revenue beat, the stock would not have drifted down into the print. Sized small because published-title revenue carries developer royalties, so the EBIT effect is much smaller than the revenue effect.
findings.independence: SteamCharts for app 3493540: last-30-days average of 14,290 players and a peak of 34,458 (https://steamcharts.com/app/3493540). Raijin (via search snippet) estimates ~298k Steam copies by 4 October. Paradox's own launch release, 2026-09-29: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/media/press-releases/press-release/transport-fever-3-the-latest-entry-in-the-best-selling-transport-simulation-series-lands-on-pc-and-consoles-today

findings.finding: Steam monthly-average players summed over eight owned franchises (EU5, CK3, HOI4, Stellaris, CS1, CS2, Victoria 3, AoW4) were ~99.5k in Q3 2026: +8.7% YoY on EU5 (not out in Q3 2025) and CS2 (+45%), but -5% QoQ. September was weak: CK3 -16%, EU5 -14%, CS1 -11% and HOI4 -10% month on month. With USD/SEK ~+4% YoY, that supports roughly 440 MSEK from the catalogue, a touch under the 446 MSEK bar before any Transport Fever 3 contribution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: revenue 395 MSEK came in under the 399 bar, EBIT 112 beat the 103 bar, and the stock rose 3.3%. EBIT, not revenue, has decided the sign.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-28 (monthly series read on this date; per-title pages also at /app/3450310, /app/394360, /app/281990, /app/949230, /app/255710, /app/529340, /app/1669000)
findings.why_not_priced: Proxy. Engagement is not revenue, since DLC timing drives revenue, and analysts can read the same Steam data. It is filed because it is the one independent series for this business, and it says the catalogue alone sits roughly at the bar rather than above it.
findings.independence: FX from Yahoo USDSEK=X monthly closes: Q3 2025 ~9.44, Q3 2026 ~9.85 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/USDSEK=X?range=2y&interval=1mo)

findings.finding: Paradox sold Playrion for EUR 2.25m upfront plus a 9% net-revenue earn-out over three years. Closing was expected on 30 September 2026, the last day of Q3, and the acquisition goodwill was already fully amortised at group level. A small disposal gain, perhaps 10-25 MSEK against a 105 MSEK EBIT bar, may therefore sit in Q3 operating profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior disposal gain at Paradox to compare with. On the European resolved days, beats made of one-offs were sold (H&M).
findings.why_not_priced: The bar may or may not include the gain. Handelsbanken's 7 October note mentions removing Playrion's operations, not a gain. Even so, a headline EBIT beat built on a one-off is discounted, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Trophy Games' inside-information release gives the same terms, and Playrion revenue of about EUR 4m that is cash-flow neutral: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd5fb5543db2697adadd61589c09251b8&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Handelsbanken cut EPS 2026-28 by 4-7% on 7 October, partly on 'higher costs and earnings dilution from new game launches'. The 105 MSEK EBIT bar is below last year's 112 on revenue +13%, a margin of ~23.5% against ~28%. In Q2 EBIT missed the bar by 7.6% on costs. Q3 carried Transport Fever 3 launch marketing and Gamescom (Afterworld reveal), so the cost line is the main risk to the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EBIT miss: -7.6% on the day. Q4 2025: -15.2%.
findings.original_quote: Banken sänker prognoserna för vinst per aktie 2026–2028 med 4–7 procent, bland annat efter borttagning av Playrion samt högre kostnader och resultatutspädning från nya spellanseringar. (The bank cuts its 2026-2028 EPS forecasts by 4-7 percent, partly after removing Playrion and on higher costs and earnings dilution from new game launches.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the cut predates the 28 October Bloomberg consensus, which already sits below last year's EBIT. Filed because Q2 showed that consensus under-modelled costs even after previews, and Q3 carried a launch.
findings.independence: Q2 EBIT miss against FactSet, 182 vs 197: https://www.placera.se/telegram/paradox-interactive-paradox-okade-rorelseresultatet-men-lagre-an-vantat-20260806

findings.finding: The SEK 200m buyback finished on 8 October, so the stock has had no buyback bid for three weeks. The previous programme was announced on the evening before the Q2 report (5 August), so a renewal alongside the Q3 report is plausible but not signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 report came with a newly announced buyback and still fell 7.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference only. A renewal is not announced and could be priced as an expected capital-return habit. The stock's slide since the programme ended is consistent with the bid having gone.
findings.independence: The 5 August 2026 buyback resolution, filed the evening before the Q2 report: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b07e47b605b6c54f51cb4a8a1df30b7ab&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: No write-down release has been filed for Q3. Paradox's last two large impairments, Life by You (208 MSEK, June 2024) and Bloodlines 2 (355 MSEK, November 2025), each went out as a separate MAR release before the report, so the left tail from a capitalised-development write-down is thinner than usual.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 (the Bloodlines 2 write-down quarter): -15.2% on the report day.
findings.original_quote: Paradox Interactive AB skriver ned 355 MSEK av kapitaliserade utvecklingskostnader för Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 (2025-11-26 release title: Paradox writes down MSEK 355 of capitalised development costs for Bloodlines 2)
findings.why_not_priced: An absence. The market may already assume no write-down, so the size is small. Smaller items can still appear inside the report without a separate release.
